sentences.text: The Comedian is a 2016 American comedy-drama film directed by Taylor Hackford and written by Lewis Friedman , Richard LaGravenese , Art Linson , and Jeff Ross .	Taylor Hackford	Taylor Hackford	Art Linson	Art Linson	Jeff Ross	Jeff Ross	Richard LaGravenese	Richard LaGravenese	Lewis Friedman	Lewis Friedman	comedy-drama film	Comedy-drama

The film stars Robert De Niro , Leslie Mann , Danny DeVito , Edie Falco , Veronica Ferres , Charles Grodin , Cloris Leachman , Patti LuPone and Harvey Keitel .	Robert De Niro	Robert De Niro	Leslie Mann	Leslie Mann	Danny DeVito	Danny DeVito	Edie Falco	Edie Falco	Veronica Ferres	Veronica Ferres	Charles Grodin	Charles Grodin	Cloris Leachman	Cloris Leachman	Patti LuPone	Patti LuPone	Harvey Keitel	Harvey Keitel

The film had its world premiere at the AFI Fest on November 11 , 2016 and was released on December 9 , 2016 , by Sony Pictures Classics .	Sony Pictures Classics	Sony Pictures Classics	AFI Fest	AFI Fest
The film opened to negative reviews from critics .
